theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in Fᶜ, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (-ν z) ∂μ
